newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 9-day fixed system rp's.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 9-day fixed system rp's.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system through nine-day system repurchases agreements on Tuesday, a Fed spokesman confirmed.
Analysts had expected the Fed to refrain from operations, though they said the Fed had a large add need in the second week of the current two-week reserve maintenance period.
Fed funds were trading at 5-1/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate, analysts said.
